name: Churches of the Pskov School of Architecture
description: In the northwestern Russian city of Pskov, beside the Velikaya River, stand ten churches and monasteries that form a distinctive local style. Their plain cubic forms, domes, porches and belfries are often set within gardens and walls. The oldest parts date from the 12th century, and the style peaked in the 15th and 16th centuries, when Pskov's builders also worked in Moscow and Kazan.
